items.title: Proposition 9.2: base change of a closed-immersion pushout
items.statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks X01→X0, X01→X1, X0→X, X1→X, where i and j are closed immersions. Let f:Y→X be a map of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks. Then the induced diagram Y×X X01→Y×X X0, Y×X X1→Y is also a pushout square of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks; the induced maps i′ and j′ are also closed immersions. Complete statement and proof retained.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit proves a concrete non-routine base-change stability statement for closed-immersion pushouts by reducing to affine X and Y and applying Corollary 6.5 (statement and proof, physical page 47). It is a genuine structural step but supports Theorem 9.1 rather than being an independent H3 construction.
